plain.li: [nemesisreturn,first] A year since {ENEMY} came back for us, and found the gate shut. I stood on the wall at dusk, to remember how it looked.
[nemesisreturn,years] {YEARS} years since {ENEMY} came back. We tell it at supper now, and nobody's voice shakes any more.
[nemesisreturn] The day {ENEMY} came back. I remember thinking it would never end, and then it did.

blunt.li: [nemesisreturn] {ENEMY} came back on this day. We held. Still here.

gloomy.li: [nemesisreturn] The day {ENEMY} came back. Every year I wonder if this is the year {ENEMY} tries again.

cold.li: [nemesisreturn] Anniversary of {ENEMY}'s return. The defenses were adequate. They are better now.

plain.li: [nemesisreturn,first] A year ago today {ENEMY}, the one who got away, came back to the colony with a raid, and the colony held. {A_nameDef} says it should never be forgotten what that felt like.
[nemesisreturn,years] It's {YEARS} years since {ENEMY} came back and was seen off. The newer people know the name only from the story, and {A_nameDef} means to keep it that way.
[nemesisreturn] On this day {ENEMY} came back for the colony and went away with nothing. {A_nameDef} walked the old line this morning.
[nemesisreturn] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} about the day {ENEMY} came back, and where everyone stood.
[nemesisreturn] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} wondered aloud where {ENEMY} is now, and agreed it didn't matter as much as it used to.
